Lore

[edit | edit source]

Kuzenbo, King of the Kappa, is a mischievous tyrant of river and lake, as cunning as he is dangerously strong. Beneath his playful antics lies a ruthless predator, one who once led thousands of kappa to terrorize mortals and dominate the waters of Japan. Bound by a strange code of honor, he was twice defeated and forced to abandon his war against humanity, though his appetite for chaos remains unchanged. Now, with gods as his prey, Kuzenbo revels in battle once more, equal parts trickster and unstoppable force. Those drawn to Kuzenbo thrive in disruption and resilience, tossing enemies aside, soaking up pressure, and turning fights into chaotic displays of control.

Abilities

[edit | edit source]
Basic Attack - Kuzenbo Basic Attack Notes:
  • If multiple enemies are in the area, the enemy closest to the center of the area will be hit
Deal Magical Damage to an enemy in front of you
  • Damage Scaling: 100% Strength + 20% Intelligence + 100% Attack Damage
  • Range: 1.92 meters
  • Cone Angle: 120 degrees
Ability Video


Passive - Water Bowl | Damage Mitigation Notes:
  • Hard Crowd Control removes half your stacks, once every 1.5 seconds
  • Gives 15% Mitigations at max stacks
Each time you take a portion of your max HP as damage (pre-mitigation), gain a stack of Water Bowl as your head fills with water, granting Damage Mitigation. Stacks last a duration and refresh when you gain another
  • Damage Mitigation: 1.5% per 2% of Max HP Taken
  • Max Stacks: 10
  • Buff Duration: 30 seconds
Ability Video


1st Ability - NeNe Kappa | Projectile Nene Kappa Notes:
  • Transfers 20% of your Health and Protections to the NeNe Kappa
  • Can bounce off walls up to 2 times
  • Can have multiple NeNe Kappas at once
  • NeNe Kappas attack once per second

This ability passes through and damages non-god enemies, but bounces off walls, and stops on enemy gods

Throw a NeNe Kappa that deals Magical Damage and can ricochet off walls. After hitting an enemy god or reaching maximum range, it bursts from its shell, Slowing them and attacking
  • Damage: 80 | 120 | 160 | 200 | 240
  • Damage Scaling: 55% Intelligence
  • Damage: 35 | 45 | 55 | 65 | 75
  • Range: 11.2 meters
  • Radius: 0.8 meters
  • Cooldown: 14 | 13.5 | 13 | 12.5 | 12 seconds
  • Cost: 60 | 65 | 70 | 75 | 80 mana
Ability Video


2nd Ability - Shell Spikes | Damage Reflect, Ability CDR Notes:
  • While active your NeNe Kappa also reflects a portion of damage taken
  • Can be activated while under the effect of Crowd Control
  • Reflected damage uses the base damage of the incoming attack, before Protections and Mitigations
  • This ability does not damage towers or phoenixes and cannot proc item effects
Extend the spikes on your back, reflecting a portion of damage taken as Magical Damage to enemies who attack you. While active, each time you take damage, reduce the Cooldown of NeNe Kappa and Sumo Slam
  • Damage Reflected: 15 | 20 | 25 | 30 | 35% of Damage Taken
  • Cooldown Reduction: 0.6 | 0.7 | 0.8 | 0.9 | 1 second
  • Buff Duration: 3 seconds
  • Cooldown: 14 | 13.5 | 13 | 12.5 | 12 seconds
  • Cost: 50 mana
Ability Video


3rd Ability - Sumo Slam | Dash Push Notes:
  • Pushed targets can be hit up to 3 times
  • Only the first wall collision deals damage
  • You can turn freely with an increased turn radius
  • Dashes for a maximum of 1.5 seconds
Dash forward, becoming Slow Immune, dealing Magical Damage to enemy minions and Silencing and Pushing the first enemy god you hit. Each subsequent enemy you hit deals damage to both that enemy and the god you are pushing. Colliding with a wall also deals damage to the pushed god
  • Damage: 60 | 95 | 130 | 165 | 200
  • Damage Scaling: 40% Intelligence
  • Radius: 0.8 meters
  • Cooldown: 14 seconds
  • Cost: 50 | 55 | 60 | 65 | 70 mana
Ability Video


Ultimate - Watery Grave | Spin Knockback Notes:
  • Damage ticks every 0.6s
  • Each hit after the first on an enemy deals 40% reduced damage
Pull into your shell and spin, summoning fierce currents that deal Magical Damage and Knock Back enemies. Gain Movement Speed, Damage Mitigation, CC Immunity, and move freely in all directions
  • First Hit Damage: 80 | 130 | 180 | 230 | 280
  • First Hit Damage Scaling: 40% Intelligence
  • Subsequent Hits Damage: 40 | 65 | 90 | 115 | 140
  • Subsequent Hits Damage Scaling: 20% Intelligence
  • Movement Speed: 30%
  • Damage Mitigation: 20%
  • Radius: 3.6 meters
  • Cooldown: 75 seconds
  • Cost: 60 | 65 | 70 | 75 | 80 mana
